Dataset: schools/ccd/enrollment/{year}/{grade}
Years available: 1986–2024

Description: This endpoint contains student enrollment data for each public school by grade. Only operational schools serving one or more grades are required to report enrollment and only these are included in this endpoint.

Source: Common Core of Data (CCD)
  The Common Core of Data is the US Department of Education's primary database on public elementary and secondary education. It provides directory and enrollment information at the school level and directory, enrollment, and finance data at the school district level.
  More: https://nces.ed.gov/ccd/

Sample code (Urban's educationdata package):
  R:
    get_education_data(level = "schools",
    source = "ccd",
    topic = "enrollment",
    filters = list(year = 2014, grade = 8))
  Stata:
    educationdata using "school ccd enrollment", sub(year=2014 grade=8)

─────

SUMMARIES (aggregate without downloading rows)

  path: schools/ccd/enrollment
  var : enrollment (the only one)
  by  : ncessch, ncessch_num, leaid, fips, grade, race, sex
  by  : also, via the pre-joined directory: title_i_eligible, school_level, school_type, school_status, bureau_indian_education, title_i_status, title_i_schoolwide, charter, magnet, shared_time, virtual, state_leaid, seasch, state_location, csa, cbsa, urban_centric_locale, congress_district_id
  stat: sum, count, avg, min, max, median, stddev, variance

  get_summary(path='schools/ccd/enrollment', var='enrollment', stat='sum', by='fips')

  Every year is returned in one call — filter years only to narrow a large result.
Found 9 variable(s):

  year [FILTER]
      Label: Academic year (fall semester)
      Definition: Year that the academic year begins (e.g., the 2013–14 academic year is 2013)
      Type: integer
      Values: "-1" : "Missing/not reported","-2" : "Not applicable","-3" : "Suppressed data"

  ncessch [FILTER]
      Label: National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) identification number
      Type: string
      Format: string
      Values: "-1" : "Missing/not reported","-2" : "Not applicable","-3" : "Suppressed data"

      Label: National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) identification number (numeric)

  leaid [FILTER]
      Label: Local education agency identification number (NCES)
      Type: string
      Format: string
      Values: "-1" : "Missing/not reported","-2" : "Not applicable","-3" : "Suppressed data"

FILTERS: only fields marked [FILTER] in describe_dataset work. The API silently ignores an unsupported filter and returns UNFILTERED data, so check before assuming a filter applied. Filter by state using FIPS codes — see lookup_codes(format_name='fips').

RESULTS ARE COMPLETE OR REFUSED, never silently truncated, so counting and averaging over what you receive is valid. A refusal reports the true size and how to narrow it — follow it rather than retrying the same query.

PASS THE SOURCE ON. Every data result ends with a provenance block naming the federal source and carrying a preformatted Cite string. The data is open under ODC-By, which asks for attribution wherever figures are reported — so name the source with the numbers, and reproduce that Cite string rather than composing one of your own.
